task_completion.description: Screaming Frog SEO Spider is launched and the target URL is entered.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Screaming Frog application window is visible with 'https://books.toscrape.com/' typed into the 'Enter URL to spider' field.

task_completion.description: The crawl of the target website is initiated and reaches 100% completion.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The progress bar in the Screaming Frog interface shows 100% and the 'Internal' tab is populated with URLs from books.toscrape.com.

task_completion.description: The 'All Inlinks' data is exported from Screaming Frog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The user navigates to 'Bulk Export' -> 'Links' -> 'All Inlinks' or uses the 'Inlinks' tab to export, and a file save dialog appears.

task_completion.description: The CSV file is saved in the specific directory ~/Documents/SEO/exports/.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window or terminal output shows a .csv file located in the /home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/ directory.

task_completion.description: The report contains the total link count and counts for empty/generic anchor text.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor shows 'anchor_text_report.txt' containing numerical values for 'total links' and specific counts for 'empty' or 'generic' (e.g., 'Click here', 'View') anchor text.

task_completion.description: The report includes at least 2 specific recommendations for improvement.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text in 'anchor_text_report.txt' includes a section for recommendations with at least two distinct bullet points or numbered items suggesting SEO improvements.

integrity.description: The agent used the Screaming Frog GUI rather than just command line scripts to simulate the audit.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show active interaction with the Screaming Frog desktop interface (clicking menus, buttons) rather than just a terminal window.

integrity.description: The report data matches the exported CSV data rather than being hallucinated.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numbers reported in the .txt file (total links) are consistent with the scale of the crawl seen in the Screaming Frog UI (which should show hundreds/thousands of links).

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the correct target domain.
integrity.visual_evidence: The URL bar in Screaming Frog and the exported file names/content reference 'books.toscrape.com'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target website is https://books.toscrape.com/. Screaming Frog's 'All Inlinks' export contains a column specifically named 'Anchor Text'. The site is a sandbox with 1,000 books; a full crawl should result in a significant number of inlinks (well over 50). The expected export directory is /home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/ and the report path is /home/ga/Documents/SEO/reports/anchor_text_report.txt.
